introBand: Teknoppy is a professional web design company in Kochi delivering custom, mobile-first, SEO-ready websites for businesses across Kochi and Ernakulam. Since 2018, we have completed 120+ website projects — from focused landing pages to large corporate portals — helping Kerala brands build a strong digital presence and generate consistent leads online.

Every business today needs more than just a website. It needs a fast, credible, search-optimised platform that turns visitors into paying customers. As a dedicated web design agency in Kochi, Teknoppy combines professional website design with on-page SEO architecture, structured schema markup, and Core Web Vitals optimisation — so your site does not just look great, it ranks and converts. Our clients include startups, hospitals, real estate firms, restaurants, manufacturers, and established enterprises across Kochi, Ernakulam, Vyttila, Edappally and Kakkanad.

process.intro: Our professional web design process follows six clearly defined stages, ensuring every project is delivered on time, within budget, and built precisely to brief.

steps.title: Discovery & Goal Mapping
steps.desc: A structured brief covering goals, audience, competitors, design direction, and technical requirements. We map your geographic service area for local SEO from the start.

steps.title: Sitemap & URL Architecture
steps.desc: Full page structure, URL plan, and internal-linking hierarchy defined before design. Prevents keyword cannibalization and ensures clean crawlability.

steps.title: Wireframing & UX Design
steps.desc: Low-fidelity wireframes first, then high-fidelity mockups. You approve the layout before a line of code is written — preventing costly late revisions.

steps.title: Development & Schema
steps.desc: Clean semantic HTML/CSS with mobile-first breakpoints. LocalBusiness, Organisation, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, and Service schema implemented during development.

steps.title: SEO Setup & Speed
steps.desc: Title tags, meta descriptions, H1/H2 hierarchy, image alt text, Core Web Vitals scoring, sitemap generation, and Google Search Console verification.

steps.title: Launch, Testing & Handover
steps.desc: Full cross-browser and cross-device testing, sitemap submission to Google, and a structured handover document covering CMS access and maintenance.

On-page SEO — optimised titles, headings, metadata, and schema for fintech search visibility in Kochi.

Stronger positioning as a credible fintech company in Kochi.
Improved engagement and an SEO-ready structure from day one.

faqs.intro: Get quick answers to standard questions about custom website design pricing, process, and technical SEO features.

items.q: What does a web design company in Kochi charge for a business website?
items.a: A professional business website typically costs between Rs. 25,000 and Rs. 1,20,000 depending on pages, features, and content complexity. Teknoppy provides detailed written quotes before any project begins.

items.q: How long does it take to design and launch a website in Kochi?
items.a: A standard 8–15 page business website typically takes 3 to 5 weeks from discovery to launch. Larger corporate sites or custom functionality can take 6 to 10 weeks. A written timeline is provided at the start.

Yes. Every website includes on-page SEO as standard — correct heading hierarchy, optimised title tags, meta descriptions, image alt text, schema markup, sitemap submission, and Search Console verification. Your site enters Google's index ready to rank.

items.q: Can I update my website myself after Teknoppy builds it?
items.a: Yes. We build on WordPress CMS, giving you a simple dashboard to add pages, update content, and publish blog posts without technical knowledge. A full handover guide and optional training session are included.

items.q: Does Teknoppy design websites for businesses outside Kochi?
items.a: Yes. Our studio is in Vyttila, Kochi, and we work with clients in Ernakulam, Edappally and Kakkanad. We also serve all Kerala — see our web design company in Kerala page.

items.q: What schema markup does Teknoppy implement on every website?
items.a: LocalBusiness, Organisation, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, and where applicable AggregateRating and Person schema. This helps qualify for Google rich results and AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity.
Yes. Every website is built mobile-first — the mobile experience is designed and tested before desktop. Most people in Kochi find local businesses on their phones, so this is non-negotiable.

items.q: Does Teknoppy provide website maintenance after launch?
items.a: Yes. Monthly maintenance plans from Rs. 3,000 per month cover updates, security monitoring, speed checks, content edits, and technical fixes.

items.q: Do you offer multilingual website development?
items.a: Yes. We build multilingual websites for businesses wanting to reach both Malayalam-speaking and international audiences — especially valuable for tourism, Ayurveda, and export-oriented businesses.

items.q: How do I get started with Teknoppy?
items.a: Contact us via the Contact page, request a quote, or book a free 30-minute consultation. We respond to all enquiries within one business day.
